channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 14
item.description:
27 development commits

Loot & Economy

  • Loot now has value‑based pricing, furniture containers have their own specific contents, and blueprints count toward inventory weight.

Combat & Enemies

  • Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Hotbar now shows an action progress bar, indicating how long actions like building or using items will take.
  • Console window is now resizable and includes a blurred backdrop, making command input clearer and UI more flexible.
  • Error overlay stacking now respects stack‑trace order, ensuring error messages are displayed correctly.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed third-person attack alignment, ensuring attacks now line up correctly with target direction.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 13
item.description:
128 development commits

Equipment & Gear

  • Rocketpack added as a new piece of equipment.
  • FPV Goggles let players control RC units while wearing them (battery‑dependent) and spawn a linked ComputerStation for distance handling.
  • Gun wear reduced from 1.0 to 0.75 per use, and turrets now display a second HP bar showing weapon condition plus an ammo counter, visible without powering off the turret.

AI & Drones

  • Scout drones patrol small monuments, raise alarms, and now feature a visible light, search behavior, and health values.
  • Guards now drop loot scaled by tier, and heavy units no longer cause client crashes on death.

Player Mechanics & Survival

  • Holding F while wounded lets players “give up”, accelerating time‑remaining and recovery‑chance drains; releasing F pauses the timer.
  • Flash grenades reworked with zone‑based flash and deafness, name‑tag hiding, adjusted damage radius, and shrapnel that adds bleed and shows visible streaks.

World & Loot

  • Entire trucks act as loot containers, can be looted, show health UI when broken, and have a reduced size for easier access.
  • Monuments no longer reset or respawn loot, all NPCs have been removed from the world, and the Outpost has been removed from the raid map.
  • Introduced a Tier 2 solo/duo Container Shelter prototype with a Tier 0 workbench and a destroyable door/shelter.
  • Hub now has its own arrival markers and you no longer see the map or death screen when arriving.

Economy & Shop

  • Supplies shop prices increased; every item now has a value and loot above‑made gear is accounted for.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 12
item.description:
78 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Flamethrower now fires correctly in first‑person view.

Reviving & Healing

  • Reviving another player no longer resets their wounded timer, and the timer now only pauses while holding E, preventing griefers from resetting revive progress.

Monuments & Spawns

  • Monument guards are now tier‑based, with weaker factions placed under the scientists.
  • Beach spawn algorithm updated for fairer distribution, allowing more spawn points on varied coastlines and reducing monument check radius.

Raiding & Loot

  • Safe pocket is now counted as carried loot and the map is cleared after a raid, affecting loot accounting.
  • Loot box interaction delay reduced, allowing faster looting.

Extraction & Events

  • Extraction balloons now show a countdown timer on the map and close sequentially.
  • Airfield puzzle replaced with an NPC mission: pressing the tower button summons two chinooks to drop scientists.

Vehicles & Catapults

  • Catapult no longer launches players off the map due to mounting changes.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Reviving another player with a syringe now plays the correct third‑person sound effect.
  • Woolly Boots can be crafted (10 wool, 5 leather, 1 sewing kit); they silence footstep and jump noises but reduce projectile protection.
